## Bathcat exact-head handoff — DO NOT MERGE

**Base/head:** `e0e47b2f7593f5ee34c25c5695be9b6bed172afd` → `51f15ea9b2857fd18db3c4acb500cc61f7963f8e` on `kb/forgotten-waters-rules-components`.

**Target boundary:** English 2020 first/release PH2900 base game. The integral release-era app is governing law, not an adaptation. Its 2020 functional role is authoritative, but its immutable build/scenario/data manifest is unresolved. Current app v1.12.0 and its bytes are current-only evidence. The 2024 printer-friendly Entry Book v0.1.0 substitutes for app use for five named scenarios but is not backdated as proof of exact 2020 app content. Remote assistant, Kraken's Eye/FWDLC01 + 100+ events, solo/low-count variants, translations, promos, later revisions, *A Sea of Legends*, fan files, and adaptations are excluded.

**Primary receipts:** rules PDF 6,942,206 B / 8 pp / `9bcbd1cbe32ebde0ce326cb17a5a3dd767b5c40b5dfd15c647ef9803d93c410a`; player sheets 4,410,197 B / 42 pp / `2f79f08f0345f397efc86749df5f0989722a83074dea638ce07264fad9fe48c8`; product HTML 62,640 B / `309c142e00e1d88d7a6cc7dcfbb48790a1ae3521e36d5f000d23cc14ad9d08e5`; 2020 FAQ 33,061 B / `942595aee3ff06be02b4b01b6a17c6c52526f3bea664b66fc604d005db807c2e`; current app HTML 7,753 B / `31849e100bb1bc1e387e10530bf68e37d6e4fc488aae469db3b2c63df0169eea`; current main JS 25,763,159 B / `4ba98cb8c67d8bd0bafd482ed3963a6b6a9052c0172a5243486040c2634ed884`; Entry Book 9,695,283 B / 148 pp / `7711e3b336cf2047c0e76111027d1206250398c376f00b306554916d9cede7e2`. Exact secondary receipts are in `sources.okf.md` and PR body. Wayback CDX timed out and the historical update-log lead returned 404; neither was converted to negative proof.

**Arithmetic/denominator:** preserved all printed inventory rows. Known fixed total is 384 = 204 cards + 7 d12 + 9 books/boards + 164 other dials/tokens/markers/standees/stands, plus two pads whose internal sheet quantities are unknown. The physical face/side/surface denominator and digital scenario/entry/branch/check/audio/build denominator remain UNKNOWN; no percentage or composite is claimed.

**Ledger/rules:** `scout-report.okf.md` separately records all physical and digital governing classes and known-vs-UNKNOWN semantics. Six standard rule records cover setup; player-sheet prep; app/scenario/location initialization; timed infamy-order placement; action/check/d12/misfortune/reroll framework; ship tracks/resources/damage/failure; constellations/personal endings; entry/save flow; player-count setup; victory/loss; and bounded edge cases. Narrative/card/sheet/app-local content remains UNKNOWN and no scripts/endings/audio were reproduced. Deckbuilder judgment: **not a deckbuilder** (no personal acquisition/draw/discard/deck cycle).

**Reception:** Dicebreaker receipt `3bcc4db17e51a3df33b27234d25829f96e1e90cb35a7bbf579f6311620d4ebdd`; Bumbling Through Dungeons `17364997dcc94b4ef552cfcd2a99b1dbab4fb8720caefef26e04a46c101eeaf4`. Claims are witness-bounded; no consensus language.

**Visual proof:** canonical paths overwritten in place with noncontiguous reduced rules pp.2/4/5/7. Hashes: `cd031f...`, `908ad630...`, `7a4db126...`, `12074114...`; 600×408 contact `5c4c888e...`. Visual inspection: four distinct, uncorrupted, edition-fit, non-narrative panels; ordinary text below practical replacement quality; no excluded-content leakage.

**Validation/CI:** focused records clean; full OKF `2619 file(s) clean + INDEX fresh`; Node intake/provenance/visual suite 37 tests / 36 pass / 1 intentional skip / 0 fail; committed-head intake diff gate clean; diff-check clean. GitHub `validate` passed in 26s on exact head `51f15ea9b2857fd18db3c4acb500cc61f7963f8e` (run 30627367291 / job 91145624912).

**Residual help:** (1) confirmed English 2020 first-print physical inspection with SKU/lot/printing markers and nonreplacement face/side identities; (2) immutable release-era app build/scenario/data manifest; (3) authoritative FAQ/errata/support inventory; (4) licensed narrative/audio denominator that can be audited without unlawful mirroring.

All target records remain `needs_followup`; PR remains OPEN + DRAFT. No approval, promotion, ready mark, review, or merge was performed.

Audit and merge disposition: one wholly fresh Mennonite on the exact live head; T remains final company authority.

**DO NOT MERGE.**

## REVISE — exact-head Mennonite audit

**Audited immutable state:** base `e0e47b2f7593f5ee34c25c5695be9b6bed172afd` → head `51f15ea9b2857fd18db3c4acb500cc61f7963f8e` (`kb/forgotten-waters-rules-components`). Local HEAD, tracking ref, remote branch, and `refs/pull/17/head` all matched. One branch-scoped PR; OPEN + DRAFT + CLEAN/MERGEABLE; clean worktree; one commit / 19 paths; `git diff --check` clean. **Do not approve or merge.**

The load-bearing defect is the claim that the release-era scenario total is UNKNOWN. A dated official publisher source closes that denominator at **five**. Other Bathcat-fixable source, ledger, and metadata defects remain, so this cannot receive `HOLD — REPAIR ACCEPTED` yet.

### Independent source/app receipts

- Official rulebook: HTTP 200, `application/pdf`, 6,942,206 B, 8 letter pages, SHA-256 `9bcbd1cbe32ebde0ce326cb17a5a3dd767b5c40b5dfd15c647ef9803d93c410a`; created 2019-11-14, modified 2020-02-26. The live product-page object `.../c536.../rules_1.pdf` reproduced byte-for-byte (`cmp=0`).
- Replacement player sheets: HTTP 200, PDF, 4,410,197 B, 42 pages at 648×468 pt, SHA-256 `2f79f08f0345f397efc86749df5f0989722a83074dea638ce07264fad9fe48c8`; created 2020-01-02, modified 2020-04-10; product-page object byte-identical. These are **42 PDF pages**, not proof of 42 retail-pad sheets or release collation.
- Product page: HTTP 200, HTML, 62,640 B, SHA-256 `309c142e00e1d88d7a6cc7dcfbb48790a1ae3521e36d5f000d23cc14ad9d08e5`; PH2900 context and support links reproduced.
- 2020-03-20 App FAQ: HTTP 200, HTML, 33,061 B. Current fetch hash drifted to `5b8ee35895f4491de86d650b4341df759957c4bb864f1d66b4f76e60c87911fa` from the recorded same-size dynamic-page hash; the cited semantics remained present: app required, replaces timer/event books, JSON-fed entries, history-sensitive variation, audio/ambience, offline PWA except audio, physical save state, and possible future additions.
- **Missing release source:** official 2020-06-10 “Meet the Captains” page, HTTP 200, HTML, 28,743 B, SHA-256 `754d8dd68cee421bf451cebf9689d276477e1d9b007e8abe8cde973345e04eae`, says: “All five scenarios in the Forgotten Waters app now include full narration.” This is release-era official authority and establishes the target scenario count as **5**, although it does not close entry/branch/file/build bytes.
- **Archived update log recovered:** Wayback CDX returns publisher captures at 2020-08-03, 2020-10-20, and 2021-01-18; replay of the 2020-10-20 capture succeeded (12,233 B, SHA-256 `b84d5202ace004b9f2ee484ddc6cf78a79c948dfac86e9d51083600101b4ad12`). It records v1.2 (2020-04-21, Witch’s Heart audio), v1.2.1 (2020-04-22, Beyond correction), v1.2.1.1 (2020-04-23, Witch correction), v1.3 (2020-05-05, Nature’s Splendor audio), v1.4.1 (2020-05-19, Dead or Alive audio), and v1.6.1 (2020-08-19). Thus “archive timed out / update-log 404” is no longer the terminal evidence state. Immutable release bundle bytes remain unresolved, but dated build/version boundaries and four release scenario titles are now recoverable.
- Current app receipts reproduced exactly: HTML 7,753 B / `31849e...`; main JS 25,763,159 B / `4ba98c...`; service worker 1,181 B / `ee4177...`; manifest 644 B / `8d3d1992a47d4baa218facf639237255d30ee28c3448a1140d53d16c58ebd963`. Current metadata is v1.12.0. Structural inspection, without reproducing narratives, found 6 English scenario roots: the five base titles plus later `Kraken's Eye`; 69 locale/scenario rows across 13 locales; English roots use scenario + `generic2` + `generic`; 7,941 literal audio paths (7,850 MP3, 91 WAV). These prove **current** structure only.
- Wayback app search was retried. `fwcrossroads.plaidhatgames.com/*` returned no 2020 CDX objects; `www.fwcrossroads.com/` has first root captures from August 2020. The replayed 2020 HTML points to historical asset names, but its main bundle was not archived/retrievable. Do not infer absence.
- 2024 printer-friendly Entry Book reproduced: PDF, 9,695,283 B, 148 letter pages, SHA-256 `7711e3...`, created 2024-02-14, v0.1.0. Its front matter names Beyond the Ocean’s Edge, Witch’s Heart, Dead or Alive, Spoils of the Damned, and Nature’s Splendor. Together with the store wording “First Five Scenarios,” this aligns structurally with the release count, but it does not backdate prose/entry equality.
- The **current product support link** now serves a distinct later Entry Book: 34,031,011 B, 154 pages, SHA-256 `7ce652179b4a58dc2d6addd665e647f887781c203a6c7dc1b2714bd10a66fe32`, created 2025-09-19. This later revision must be expressly dispositioned, not conflated with the 2024 v0.1.0 printer-friendly object.
- **Missing official ship-log source:** live product support exposes `shiplog.pdf`: HTTP 200, PDF, 326,362 B, 2 pages at 648×468 pt, SHA-256 `0b1e7fc0d70c63689077a52bb1bbdcbcf46b09204d0a04121f8ad7004bce6244`, created 2019-11-04, modified 2020-03-23. It closes the replacement log’s two PDF faces/surfaces, while retail pad multiplicity/collation remains UNKNOWN.
- Remote Assistant and FWDLC01/Kraken’s Eye remain correctly later/supplemental. Review scopes reproduced: Charlie Theel / Dicebreaker / 2021-03-22; Mark Wilson (site schema `mawilson4`) / Bumbling Through Dungeons / 2021-01-12 (modified 2021-06-14). Dynamic HTML hashes drifted on Dicebreaker and the Entry Book store page at identical byte sizes; cited passages remained semantically present.

### Printed inventory arithmetic

All 34 printed rows reconcile. Line inventory:

`1 rulebook; 7 d12; 1 location book; 1 map board; 6 named role boards; 1 ship-scribe pad; 1 player-sheet pad; 89 treasure cards; 10 objective cards; 96 story cards; 7 player treasure-chest cards; 5 location dials; 2 special-rules cards; 8 cannon tokens; 25 reroll tokens; 20 misfortune tokens; 9 lock tokens; 15 constellation-event tokens; 20 special-location tokens; 30 navigation tokens; 5 threat tokens; 1 each hull/supplies/crew/discontent marker; 7 infamy markers; 7 pirate standees; 1 ship standee; 8 stands.`

- Cards: `89+10+96+7+2 = 204`.
- Dice: `7`.
- Books/boards: `1 rulebook + 1 location book + 1 map + 6 role boards = 9`. “Books/boards” is an honest arithmetic umbrella, not a face/surface denominator.
- Other: `5+8+25+20+9+15+20+30+5+1+1+1+1+7+7+1+8 = 164`.
- Fixed rows excluding pad containers: `204+7+9+164 = 384`.
- Counting each pad as one physical container gives `386` retail units, but the unknown internal sheet multiplicities prevent a sheet total. The PR’s “384 plus two pads” formulation is acceptable.

One first-print scope defect remains: the official 2020-06-05 release post says the promotional treasure-chest organizer was available with **all first-print-run copies**. It is not a p.2 inventory row, but this first/release target must explicitly disposition that organizer as bundled first-print promotional material or narrow the target/exclusion; it may not disappear from the physical ledger.

### Governing ledger and representative rules

The six rules records correctly trace the release rulebook’s framework: first-game tutorial and setup; 3/4-player special cards; app/View Setup; location/map/token/deck/player prep; timed planning in high-to-low infamy order and +1 discontent on timeout; numbered action resolution with infamy ordering; required/limited/locked/unlimited occupancy; d12 checks, misfortune, rerolls, skill/constellation advancement; navigation/ship stats/cannons/treasure/story/objective frameworks; shared hull/discontent/threat losses; individual 4/5-event victory qualification and endings; page transitions, ties, save/resume, and initial scaling. No later-app rule import or review-as-rule use was found. “Not a deckbuilder” is correct: shared supplies and face-up treasure holdings do not create a personal acquire/draw/discard deck loop.

The physical ledger dispositions are mostly sound: rulebook; location book page/action/warning/end-round surfaces; map/navigation/special-location mapping; six role boards/tracks; all five card classes; player-sheet constellations/events/backstories/endings; ship logs; dice; dials/tokens/markers/standees/stands. Physical object counts are correctly kept separate from face/side/text identity.

Digital ledger repair is still required: add an explicit **app-local check-data/check-instruction** class and mark release IDs/counts/mappings/text UNKNOWN. The PR body names “check” in the unresolved denominator, but `scout-report.okf.md`’s actual digital class bullets omit it. Also bind the recovered version/update-log evidence without pretending it supplies release bundle bytes.

### Mechanics, reception, visuals, and structure

- **Semi-cooperative metadata was removed incorrectly.** Release rules combine common catastrophic losses with individual victory qualification and ordered personal endings; the official product page says players pursue personal stories and a common goal; Bumbling explicitly describes selfishness that keeps play from feeling fully cooperative. This directly fits the controlled `semi-cooperative-game` slug. Restore it consistently across all 12 game records and regenerate the index. The old BGG weight/rating was not preserved with a current auditable source, so `weight: null` and removal of drift-prone rating prose are honest.
- Reception is witness-bounded and supported. `accessibility` properly represents mandatory-device exclusion; `downtime` and `turn-pacing` are supported by long voiceovers/session length; `strategic-depth` by repetitive/light checks and modest strategy. No market-consensus claim was made. Add the omitted Bumbling publication date to its source receipt.
- Visuals: all four transforms reproduced byte-for-byte from the verified PDF with the documented 100-dpi/crop/Lanczos/WebP recipe: `cd031f...`, `908ad6...`, `7a4db1...`, `120741...`; dimensions 300×184 and bytes 12,006 / 12,928 / 13,104 / 12,914. Contact sheet is 600×408, 50,050 B, `5c4c888e...`. Native inspection found distinct, uncorrupted, edition-fit, noncontiguous panels with no story/ending/later-content leakage. Headings and some component names are legible, but ordinary paragraph text is not practically readable and the four partial crops cannot replace the rulebook; visual repair is not required.
- All 12 target records are `needs_followup`; 59 claims have adjacent Source/Evidence/Confidence triplets; internal links resolve. Generated index/telemetry diff is scoped and fresh according to exact-head CI.

### Exact repair matrix

1. **Release denominator — REPAIR:** register/cite the official 2020-06-10 source and replace “release-era total UNKNOWN” with “release count KNOWN = 5; complete title/build/entry/branch/check/audio byte manifests still not fully closed.” Preserve title uncertainty only to the degree not supplied by recovered dated sources.
2. **Release app evidence — REPAIR:** replace the stale terminal Wayback-timeout/404 account with the successful CDX/replay ledger and dated v1.2→v1.6.1 history; do not overclaim immutable build identity.
3. **Ship logs — REPAIR:** add the official two-page PDF receipt and update the ledger: replacement faces known; retail-pad multiplicity/collation/revision identity still open.
4. **First-print organizer — REPAIR:** explicitly include or edition-scope-exclude the organizer proved bundled with all first-print copies; keep it separate from p.2 arithmetic.
5. **Digital class ledger — REPAIR:** add check data/instructions explicitly; retain UNKNOWN release denominator/mapping/text.
6. **Mechanics — REPAIR:** restore `semi-cooperative-game` to every target record and regenerate `INDEX.okf.md`/telemetry in the prescribed final pass.
7. **Later Entry Book boundary — REPAIR:** distinguish the live 2025 154-page support object from the bounded 2024 v0.1.0 printer-friendly source and exclude it unless separately in scope.
8. **Reception receipt — REPAIR:** add Bumbling’s 2021-01-12 publication date (and optionally modified date); retain current witness-bounded claims.
9. **Live PR prose — REPAIR:** update the body’s scenario/Wayback/support claims and residual-help list to match the repaired corpus; historical handoff may remain historical.

After repair, residual external help may still lawfully remain: confirmed PH2900 first-print physical inspection/lot markers and nonreplacement face-side identity; an immutable release app bundle/data/audio manifest and comparison to current; any authoritative FAQ/errata inventory beyond the recovered update log; and licensed narrative/audio denominators without unlawful mirroring.

### CI / governance

Exact-head Actions run `30627367291`, job `91145624912`, `validate` **SUCCESS**, head SHA matched; substantive intake/provenance/OKF/visual steps ran successfully. Green CI proves structure, not the source/denominator/metadata truth defects above.

**Verdict: REVISE.** Return the same OPEN+DRAFT PR to a fresh Bathcat repair context, then require a wholly fresh Mennonite audit on the new exact head. T remains final authority. I made no file edit, approval, ready-state change, review, or merge. **DO NOT MERGE.**

**Exact audit binding:** base `e0e47b2f7593f5ee34c25c5695be9b6bed172afd` → repaired head `1f642caf0198149e35faab5b856847f24a7701b5` on `kb/forgotten-waters-rules-components`. Every Bathcat-fixable defect from the prior exact-head `REVISE` is closed. Forgotten Waters must remain an **audited open-gap PR**, not completed canon: OPEN, DRAFT, `needs_followup`, unapproved, and unmerged. **DO NOT MERGE.**

### Repair closure matrix

1. **Release scenario denominator — closed.** `src-013` now records the dated official 2020-06-10 statement that all five app scenarios had narration. The corpus says release count **KNOWN = 5**, while correctly preserving the complete immutable release title/build/data/entry/check/branch/audio manifests as UNKNOWN. 3. **Ship log omission — closed.** The official two-page replacement PDF is registered and the ledger distinguishes two replacement PDF faces/surfaces from UNKNOWN retail-pad multiplicity, collation, and revision identity.
4. **First-print organizer / 384–386 convention — closed.** The organizer is separately dispositioned as an all-first-print bundled promotional accessory outside rulebook p.2 arithmetic and governing content; unknown internal particulars are not falsely counted.
